deep_dive.executive_summary: Cboe Global Markets is a toll collector on global derivatives, cash equities, and market-data subscriptions with minimal balance-sheet risk. FY2025 filings confirm $4,714.2 million revenues, $1,467.1 million operating income, and $1,752.6 million operating cash flow; Q1 2026 held momentum at $1,272.8 million net revenues. At $285.23 per share, we expect about 13.42% per year over 7 years on $16.00 mid-cycle free cash flow per share (below our about-fifteen-percent-per-year accumulate bar). The SPX/VIX franchise and recurring Data Vantage fees support a durable moat, but transaction revenue ...
